Job Description:
Join Hitachi Energy and become part of a global team driving innovation in the energy sector. As a PO, you will join a product team developing advanced energy applications for performance‑critical systems, including algorithms that determine the state of electrical power networks. You will work closely with software developers, scientists from Hitachi Energy Research, and Product Management to deliver smarter, greener, and more reliable energy solutions.
How you’ll make an impact:
Supports Product Management (PM) in customer discussions (and engagements) to better understand needs, pain points, and workflows.​
Act as R&D’s guardian, by reviewing (an ultimately approving) PM drafted business requirements to ensure they are sufficiently detailed for R&D consumption (i.e., requirements are understood & actionable). ​
Decomposes business requirements into a detailed set of functional and non-functional requirements (i.e., technical requirements), the same subsequently sent for PM review & approval.​
Ensures that all required development artifacts (e.g., estimates, flow diagrams, OLH, product handbooks, development record, etc.) are created and approved (when deemed fit for purpose), be that by him/herself or other members of the assigned development team (incl. architects and suchlike).​
Acts as the Voice of the Customer (and/or other stakeholders) during development & deployment, providing/obtaining timely clarifications to/for the development team (and/or other stakeholders) as/when required.​
Together with Tier 2A: Solution-Level Stewards, acts as R&Ds main focal point between the development team(s) and all major stakeholders.​
Supports development team managers in the discharge of their duties (e.g., prioritizing feature workitems, evaluating development progress, validation, etc.).​

Other key activities​
Creates (with the development team) and subsequently grooms related feature development artifacts in the working backlog (e.g., ADO work items - user stories, tasks, issues & linked bugs), while ensuring documented acceptance criteria has been attained prior to closure.​
Identifies and highlights scope changes/slippages at the earliest opportunity, ensuring the change control process is triggered as/when necessary.​

Identifies the need to capture development items in release notes and/or other customer facing material (e.g., training, sales & marketing), providing input as/when necessary.​
Your background
At least 5 years in Product Owner role in software development.
Master Electrical/Power Systems Engineering, or Master’s degree with equivalent electric power industry experience. Familiarity with WAMS/WAMPAC, PMU data, and protection and control applications or power system dynamics would be added advantage
Experience working in Agile software development environments with in-depth knowledge of Agile principles, processes, and best practices.
Sharp analytical mind and skills to solve problems and extract their essence.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Good communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
Willingness to work in an international project set-up and excellent team player
Understanding (by education or professional experience) of power system domain
Nice to have: Technical experience in software development and experience in UX.
Proficiency in English

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working hours
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy, both within Sweden and globally
Various training and education supporting employee development
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave

jobs.occupation: Senior VIL Operations and Automation Engineers
jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining EDAG?
EDAG, one of the leading global engineering experts with heritage from the automotive industry, serves its customers with complete development responsibility, ranging from concept work to even building prototypes. Whether it is software development, development of future mobility solutions, sustainability, design engineering, quality assurance, manufacturing engineering or various other engineering requests, EDAG has successfully helped its clients take the next technology leap, for more than 56 years.
We at EDAG simply claim to be our customer’s global mobility and industry engineering experts! EDAG Engineering Scandinavia AB is the Scandinavian subsidiary of the EDAG Group. With an origin from Gothenburg, we have naturally become an important partner to the western region of Sweden. More and more customers are discovering our ability to deliver local engineering capabilities within a wide range of areas – not seldom in combination with other global EDAG sites, colleagues and competences to accommodate larger projects and undertakings.
We are expanding our customer engagement and looking for Senior VIL Engineers who will develop, operate, maintain, and continuously improve advanced VIL, Vehicle-in-the-Loop, test environments. The assignment supports multiple vehicle projects and hardware architectures and combines hands-on rig operations, systematic fault tracing, test-environment development, and automation using CAPL and Python.

Responsibilities:
Developing and maintaining VIL test environments according to lifecycle management processes.
Developing automated solutions for VIL environments using Python and CAPL.
Operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced automotive test rigs.
Integrating and maintaining hardware, software, networks, embedded systems, and automation solutions.
Performing systematic fault tracing and root-cause analysis across electrical, mechanical, network, embedded-software, and test-system domains.
Handling support tickets, incident tickets, intake requests, and improvement proposals.
Improving rig stability, monitoring, automation, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Working with different vehicle platforms, architectures, hardware configurations, and mainly the Vector toolchain.
Contributing technical feedback to documentation and electrical schematics.
Collaborating closely with Volvo Cars core teams, stakeholders, Product Owners, and technical leadership.
Taking ownership of assigned project deliveries and reporting status and progress continuously.
Participating in daily stand-ups, sprint activities, technical reviews, and regular team demonstrations

Qualifications:
M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
Solid experience in automotive test environments, embedded systems, rig operations, test development, or complete-vehicle-level testing.
Strong experience in fault tracing, root-cause analysis, and hands-on troubleshooting.
Experience in rig maintenance, operations, and continuous improvement.
Good understanding of vehicle communication architecture.
Deep understanding of CAN, LIN, and Ethernet communication protocols.
Experience with diagnostic communication protocols.
Experience with Vector CANoe and CANalyzer and other Vector systems.
Experience with Wireshark and automotive communication analysis.
Programming or scripting experience in Python and CAPL.
Experience with test-environment automation frameworks.
Understanding of CI/CD concepts and development workflows.
Experience working with source code, documentation, and work items in Azure DevOps.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with customer stakeholders and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Strong technical curiosity, a structured troubleshooting approach, and a delivery-oriented mindset.
Fluent in English, written and spoken.
B driving license.

Meritorious:
Previous experience from VIL or other advanced automotive rig environments.
Experience with large-scale automotive test development and complete-level testing.
Knowledge of Lifecycle Management, LCM, for test environments.
Experience with DLT, DSA, or PD.
Experience across multiple vehicle platforms, architectures, or hardware configurations.
Background or strong interest in mechatronics, robotics, or advanced automation.

Why Join EDAG?
Work on cutting-edge automotive software and technologies.
Collaborate with leading automotive companies and industry experts.
Influence technical strategy and operational excellence.
Be part of a collaborative and innovative engineering culture.
Opportunity to lead high-impact teams delivering quality automotive solutions.

If you are interested in the role please apply at the earliest?

The opportunity
With a pioneering technology-leading offering, Hitachi Energy’s Power Quality Solutions support the green energy transition with solutions that bring resilience, stability and increased capacity to the power grid. As a result, more renewable energy sources can be integrated, environmental impacts minimized and lower the risk of disruption in the grid.
At Hitachi Energy, we value our people as our greatest asset, as we leverage diverse thoughts, backgrounds, and experiences to foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. With our skilled and global project teams, we are there to support our customers worldwide to meet their sustainable goals, paving the way for a more sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. Join our team!
How you’ll make an impact
In this role you will design control and relay protection system, electrical plant system and auxiliary equipment.
You will also design and integrate third party’s systems.
Convert technical requirements into a validated design and ensure that customer requirements are fulfilled.
Create drawings and product configurations.
Work with our base design solutions and processes.
Support our customers and handle customer documentation.
Constantly improving of our solutions and develop new ideas.
Together with team members or independently work with delivery projects, improvement projects, and tenders.

Your background
We are looking for an engaged and driven person who are true team player with a problem-solving oriented and structured mindset.
You are proactive, look for opportunities and take responsibility for the projects and the tasks you work on.
Knowledge of Electric Cad system. Zuken E3 and Engineering Base is a benefit.
Knowledge of relay configuration.

jobs.occupation: Cloud Fullstack Developer to Sigma Connectivity!
jobs.description:
Take your cloud engineering career to the global stage: Shape cutting-edge tech with world-leading clients. Apply today and join Sigma Connectivity!
About the role
Sigma Connectivity is a tech house with a big heart for technology, people, and turning clever ideas into real-world products. The culture is built on curiosity, close collaboration, and a healthy dose of Nordic work-life balance, fostering an environment where knowledge is shared freely, new approaches are encouraged, and building great technology is genuinely enjoyed together.
Sigma Connectivity works across the entire product spectrum—from IoT devices and consumer electronics to complex cloud solutions. Projects span the full development lifecycle, guiding clients from early concepts all the way through building, scaling, testing, and shipping final solutions.
Sigma Connectivity is now looking for a Senior Cloud Fullstack Developer who thrives across the entire software stack. In this role, you’ll take a hands-on approach alongside a collaborative team, building and scaling solutions with Java, TypeScript, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). The position involves designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud-based systems, contributing directly to high-impact client projects, and driving continuous deployment practices.
A typical workweek could involve developing backend services one day, enhancing a React frontend the next, and helping automate deployment pipelines the day after. Sigma values engineers who enjoy variety, take ownership, and bring positive energy to the team.
You are offered
Unmatched Flexibility: True freedom under responsibility, allowing employees to structure their workday with ease.
Global Impact: The opportunity to collaborate directly with world-class tech giants and Silicon Valley leaders.
Continuous Growth: A dynamic environment to broaden technical expertise across diverse cloud platforms and cutting-edge technologies.

Work tasks
End-to-End Cloud Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and observable cloud-native applications and backend services.
Fullstack Development: Deliver clean, high-quality code across both backend logic and user interfaces using Java and TypeScript.
DevOps & Infrastructure: Work with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), improve CI/CD pipelines, and streamline automated deployment workflows.
Solution Architecture: Translate client requirements into pragmatic, robust technical architectures and communicate design trade-offs clearly.
Collaboration & Leadership: Share knowledge through code reviews, contribute to technical discussions, and help mentor team members.

We are looking for
Hands-on software development experience, primarily with cloud-based or distributed systems.
Expertise in Java and TypeScript, with experience across both backend and frontend development.
Practical experience with cloud platforms, cloud-native development, IaC, and modern CI/CD practices.
Solid understanding of software architecture, microservices, design patterns, clean code, scalability, and observability.
Strong communication skills in English and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, React and/or Vue.js
Specifik experience in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Worked with containers & Orchestration as Docker, Kubernetes
The IaC tools Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tooling
Hands on experience in event-driven architecture, API design, automated testing, and observability tools

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Change oriented
Stress tolerant
Responsible
Assertive

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

The opportunity
We are seeking a structured and people-oriented Product Implementation Manager who will be the responsible project manager for introduction and phase out of products in our factory. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with sales, design, R&D, production and after sales to ensure that the products we develop and discontinue are properly introduced or discontinued. You´ll be a part of the Design team at High Voltage Breakers.
You will join the design department at HV Breakers. We currently have 350 employees and are growing to meet market demands. One key area is our eco-friendly products, EconiQ. We are a fast-paced company that encourages you to take initiative and be innovative.
“If you are looking for a position where you get to lead implementation projects or smaller improvement projects demanding interaction with multiple departments and people this will be the perfect role for you!” – Sara Lingegård, Project Engineering Manager at HV Breakers.
How you´ll make an impact
In a structured way manage the projects to ensure deliverables are completed on time.
Collaborate with departments such as sales, design, procurement, and production.
Manage all communication and report progress and results to the R&D Project Manager, Local Product Manager and the local management team.
This position will give you the chance to get an overview and understand the different functions and their responsibility within HV Breakers.

Your background 
You have an engineering background or relevant work experience.
As Product Implementation Manager it is essential that you are a great team player with an interest to learn about the products and the business. 
You contribute with your communication skills, as well as with your ability to motivate others.  
Prior project management experience is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
Proficient knowledge in English and Swedish is required since you need to communicate with employees in different departments and other countries.

TL;DR We're looking for an IT Engineer who treats every manual ticket as a bug. You'll automate the company's IT operations end-to-end with AI agents, so 250+ Lovables can move at terminal velocity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
5+ years in IT engineering, corporate engineering, or platform IT at a high-growth tech company.
Fluent with identity, MDM, SaaS lifecycle, and zero-trust networking (Okta/Entra, Jamf/Intune/Kandji, Tailscale/Cloudflare, Google Workspace).
You write real code - Python, TypeScript, or Go - and ship automations as production systems, not scripts.
Hands-on experience securing AI agents and LLM tooling (Lovable, Claude, function-calling, MCP, internal copilots) and a clear point of view on where humans should stay in the loop.
Bias toward eliminating work over optimising it. You measure success in tickets that never need to be opened.
Bonus: experience building internal developer/employee portals, or running IT for a fast-scaling org through 10x growth.

What you'll do
Optimise all aspects of Lovable's IT stack: identity, devices, SaaS, networking, and access reviews.
Build AI agents that resolve tier-1 and tier-2 IT requests automatically - onboarding, access, lost devices, app provisioning.
Administer and optimise our diverse AI toolstack, including Lovable itself, working closely with the product team on feedback and iterations
Build and maintain internal self-serve IT tooling
Replace runbooks with automated workflows and self-serve tooling our team actually loves using.
Configure integrations , build templates and default tooling that lowers thresholds for people to work AI-natively and speed up onboarding and processes.
Set the bar for how a modern, AI-native IT function looks - and write the playbook the rest of the industry will copy.
Oversee DNS records, domain strategy and email deliverability

Our Stack
Devices: macOS, Linux, Kandji, Crowdstrike
Networking: Tailscale, Cloudflare, Meter, Unifi
IAM: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra
Dev tools/data: Lovable, GitHub, BigQuery, various AI tools
GRC: Vanta, Wiz

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.description:
Do you want to build a cloud platform that helps keep medicines safe on their way to patients around the world? At TSS, you will help develop technology used by leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide to monitor temperature-sensitive medicines throughout the supply chain. You will also play a central role as TSS takes the next step from on-prem to Azure.
About the role
As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will be part of TSS's Cloud Platform team, which builds and runs the platform that TSS's applications and connected products rely on. You will design, build and operate the platform, and take an active part in technology decisions and the technical roadmap.
The platform is a product in itself. Your job is to make it easy for the application teams to build, deploy, and run their services in a secure, compliant, and reliable way. TSS operates in a regulated environment (GxP), where traceability and quality are part of everyday work. You will help turn compliance requirements into practical technical controls, without making them heavier than they need to be.
You will, among other things:

Take part in migrating TSS's on-prem/private cloud environments to Azure, including the IoT cloud that serves a global fleet of around 8,000 gateways.

Build and operate the Kubernetes (AKS) platform, including cluster lifecycle, ingress, service mesh, certificates and secrets.

Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform and Terragrunt, and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and GitOps.

Standardize deployment patterns and create templates and golden paths for the development teams.

Set up monitoring and observability and take part in operations and incident handling.

You will work closely with the application teams and the IoT team. TSS is a small organization with short decision paths, so you will have real influence and be expected to take your own initiatives.
The role is based at TSS's office in Solna, with a hybrid setup where the team typically works from the office 2 days per week.
About you
We are looking for a senior engineer with solid experience in building and running cloud platforms in production. You enjoy working close to developers, you have a pragmatic mindset, and you like driving standardization and automation.
We believe you have:

At least 5 years of experience in cloud or platform engineering.

At least 3 years of experience running containers in production, preferably with Kubernetes.

Experience designing and building platforms, not just using them.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and with CI/CD and GitOps pipelines.

Good knowledge of Linux, networking, and monitoring of cloud services.

A master's degree in a relevant technical field.

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience with Azure (AKS, Azure Policy, Container Apps), MySQL, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, service mesh and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry is a plus. We also value experience of DevSecOps, supply chain security or incident management, as well as a background in MedTech, pharma or other GxP-regulated environments.
Interested?
We review applications continuously, so feel free to apply as soon as possible.
If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Julia Lagerblad, Talent Acquisition Consultant, at julia.lagerblad@ants.se.
Please note that background checks are conducted as part of our recruitment process.

ABOUT THE POSITION AND THE COMPANY
With a wide range of products for the entire family, Biltema is a strong brand with more than 160 stores across the Nordic region and plans for further expansion. The success and vision are based on a simple concept that has been refined over the years; To make it economically easier for people to have cars, boats, homes, tools, and leisure articles of high quality, thereby creating a richer leisure time for these people. They choose their own path and have therefore decided to invest in their own operations and development of systems and technical solutions, among other things. Biltema Nordic Services is a service company within Biltema with various departments that together deliver a complete solution for the department stores' assortment and operations. The IT department in Helsingborg provides systems and digital solutions in collaboration with Biltema's other companies within the group for our Nordic markets.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions across our international organization.
Working closely with the Enterprise Architecture team, business stakeholders, project managers, and technical teams, you will own solution architecture from initial assessment through implementation and operational handover. You will ensure that projects align with our enterprise architecture principles, technology roadmap, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

YOU ARE OFFERED

To work for a company with healthy values and play an important role in the future development of Biltema's systems.

Work in an organization with clear leadership and a clear and long-term vision.

The opportunity to work at a well-managed and very prosperous company that values entrepreneurship and simplicity.

EXAMPLES OF WORK TASKS

Own end-to-end solution architecture for assigned projects, from business requirements through design, implementation and operational handover

Design secure, scalable solutions across Azure and on-premises environments, including identity, data flows and non-functional requirements

Define integration approaches between ERP platforms (Dynamics 365 and AX), business applications and data platforms

Apply enterprise architecture standards, prepare proposals for architecture reviews, and flag risks, technical debt and exceptions early

Embed security and privacy in every design, including threat modeling and production readiness

Lead workshops with business stakeholders, delivery teams and vendors, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences

Assess vendor proposals and challenge unnecessary complexity or long-term dependency

EXPERIENCE

Significant experience in solution architecture or a comparable role, with ownership of complex solutions in an enterprise environment.

Demonstrated ability to take solutions from business requirements through design, implementation, and operational transition.

Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud architecture.

Experience designing integrations across enterprise applications, including APIs, messaging, events, and data exchanges.

Working knowledge of identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, authentication, and authorization.

Ability to define non-functional requirements and make informed decisions about resilience, performance, security, and cost.

Experience working with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, developers, security teams, and external suppliers.

Strong architectural documentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Experience working within architecture governance and Agile delivery practices.

Professional fluency in English and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Start: By agreement
Working hours: Standard office hours with the possibility for hybrid work.
Location: Helsingborg
Type of employment: This assignment is a recruitment, and the employment will be directly with our client. Salary, terms, and conditions are discussed separately.
The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Therefore, Biltema Nordic Services requests that all inquiries regarding the position be directed to A-Hub.

TL;DR: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the Lovable agent end-to-end - owning quality, roadmap, and the feedback loops that make it better. You'll shape how our agent reasons, acts, and delivers for millions of users, directly influencing one of the most consequential product surfaces at Lovable.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with direct ownership of an AI or LLM-powered product in a product management or engineering leadership role

Hands-on experience building and shipping agent-based systems - you understand tool use, planning loops, multi-step reasoning, and how agents fail

Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can read model outputs, traces, and evals with confidence

Strong product sense and systems thinking - you know when to move fast and when to invest in foundational work, and you have sharp opinions on how agents should communicate, recover from errors, and earn user trust

Preferred: Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation frameworks; prior experience operating at the frontier where best practices are still being written

What you'll do
Represent the user - synthesize findings on agent performance and behavior, and bring them to the team with clarity and conviction

Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, eval analysis, prompt experimentation, and crafting messaging for upcoming agent capabilities

Own the quality bar for agent outputs - drive eval infrastructure, monitor regressions, and ensure the agent improves with every release

Scope ruthlessly - ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't

Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to communicate new agent capabilities effectively

Projects you'll tackle first: Rebuilding the agent evaluation framework to catch regressions before they ship; running discovery on the biggest gaps in agent reliability and trust; defining and shipping the first iteration of improved agent error recovery and communication

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

You'll continuously deliver software to clouds, even in production

Java 11-25

Spring 4+

Consuming and exposing REST web services from Java 

JUnit 4 or 5

Mock framework (Mockito / EasyMock)

Maven

Relational database (Oracle / MS SQL Developer / MySql)

OpenAPI specifications

Liquibase

Python or other programming languages

Test frameworks (Load tests, Security, Integration)

Automation framework (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, CloudFormation)

This is because of the current Swedish market situation

Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 
The Manufacturing technician is responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient production and maintenance operations. This position covers a broad technical scope, including production support, troubleshooting, preventive and corrective maintenance, and continuous improvements in mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and automation systems. Technicians act as first-line responders to equipment and process issues, ensuring minimum downtime and maximum output and high quality. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections. 
Perform risk analysis and participate in risk assessments according to established routines. 
Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. 
Troubleshoot and resolve production line issues (mechanical, electrical, automation, process) and completing validation runs of production to confirm the effectiveness of work. 
Support production teams with first-line problem solving and escalate unsolved issues. 
Perform corrective and preventive maintenance on production equipment (electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic). 
Install, maintain, and repair equipment, wiring, and systems (mechanical assemblies, electrical systems). 
Inspect equipment for wear, vibrations, lubrication, or electrical faults and escalate to one level above the need for repair if necessary. 
Define and manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability. 
Read and update technical documentation including (but not limited to): diagrams, blueprints, troubleshooting guidelines, checklists and work instructions. 
Train newly onboarded team members and colleagues in technical and safety procedures. 
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and maintenance program optimization. 
Ensure all work complies with safety standards and regulatory requirements. 
Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for repairs, troubleshooting and escalation. 
Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business, including but not limited to running the line, completing 5S, cleaning activities & quality sampling. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Technical/industrial background (Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or related). 
3+ years previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing) 
Vocational education within Industrial/Electrical Gymnasium or equivalent. 
Six Sigma White or Yellow Belt certification is a plus. 
Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) 
Basic IT literacy (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 
Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization. 
Experience in troubleshooting with specialized diagnostic equipment (multimeter, oscilloscope, etc). 
Experience with equipment, piping, pumps, valves, control tools, chemicals, and electronics. 
Administrative competence, including experience with ERP systems, work orders, email, and incident reporting. 

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 
A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 
A Quality Technician leads product and process quality compliance in production line. This role is responsible for confirming key quality attributes of intermediate products and processes as well as identifying and responding to non-conformity issues in production. In addition, this role is responsible for analysing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Production using a range of instruments. This role will work closely with production staff and Quality Engineers. A Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production processes and products meet internal and customers’ quality specifications as well as defining problems, recommending solutions and follows-up on improvements. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities . Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  :
Lead day-to-day quality assurance activities in production ensuring that production/product quality specifications are met.  
Ensure control checks are completed according to control plan in defined time.  
Ensure robust start of production and coordinated quality handover between shifts.   
Ensure 5S in control and measurement areas and participate in improving 5S methodology and actions together with production team.  
Ensure documentation and record of product and process quality data and utilize these to improve processes.  
Potential to operate various measurement equipment such as a Karl Fischer, measurement by ruler or micrometre, microscopes, perform testing with measuring instruments, perform basic data analysis, interpret data and report data/results as instructed.   
Interpret data and report data/results on yearly, monthly, and daily basis.  
Understand and execute the testing plans for material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products.   
Help identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Organize test results in the expected template and/or LIMS system and maintain control charts.  
Be able to troubleshoot instrument on basic and advance problems and utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Act on deviations and ensure coordination with customer processes.  
Ensure imminent containment activities and decision making in case of non-conformities and quality issues. 
Mentor less experienced personnel on practical aspects of the analysis methods such as sample preparation and running instruments.   
Maintain the instruments to a high standard.   
Ensure conformity of cleanliness requirements in process. 
Conduct Layered Product audit according to schedule.  
Contribute to improvement actions in area of responsibility.  
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No 
Direct reports: No 
Work environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Professional education (ideally in industry) is a plus. 
2 years experience in manufacturing and 2 years experience in quality.   
Bachelor´s degree in a technical field is preferred but not required. 
Previous experience of quality control from automotive industry is preferred.   
Familiar with Lean and Six Sigma concepts.  
Familiar with SPC, FMEA, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. 

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Specific knowledge of quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, TQM is preferred.   
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform work in controlled environments, including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs.

jobs.occupation: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.
If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.
At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.

About the role
As Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.
The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.

Your main responsibilities:

Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting

Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP

Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews

Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting

Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders

Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities

Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes

Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analyses

Who are we looking for?
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.
We are looking for someone who has:
• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent
• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization
• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)
• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools
• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

As a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.
We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.

What Schneider Electric offers
At Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. You will be part of a professional and forward-looking finance organization where you are encouraged to grow, challenge existing ways of working and develop your career over time.
This is a role where your expertise truly matters – and where you can make a real impact.
Learn more at www.se.com

Application
In this recruitment, Schneider Electric cooperates with Mpya Finance. Selection is ongoing, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For questions about the role or the process, please contact: Kristina Bennet – kristina.bennet@mpya.se Johanna Andersson – johanna.andersson@mpya.se 
Welcome with your application – we look forward to hearing from you.

Är du vår nästa sushi-stjärna? Bli en del av Woso-familjen!

Vi söker dig som har en passion för asiatisk matlagning inom sushi & sallad och som vill ta med den energin till vår kökspersonal i Malmö. En heltidstjänst med arbete både vardagar och helger. Ett härligt gäng kollegor och en chans att utvecklas inom restaurangen.

Are you our next sushi star? Become part of the Woso family!
Woso Sushi Salad is a popular restaurant with Japanese flavors that has made Sweden yearn for more. Our first restaurant, which opened in Malmö, laid the foundation for our adventure. Now we are looking for you who want to become part of our family and enhance our guests' taste experiences!

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who has a passion for Asian cooking in sushi & salad and who wants to bring that energy to our kitchen staff in Malmö. You have a positive attitude and contribute to a good atmosphere in the kitchen. You work efficiently and enjoy being part of a team where everyone strives towards the same goal.

What we offer
A full-time position with work both weekdays and weekends. A wonderful group of colleagues and a chance to develop within the restaurant.
- Permanent employment
- Full time
- fixed monthly salary
- No requirement to be able to work with sushi before
----------------------------------

Vị trí toàn thời gian, làm việc cả ngày trong tuần và cuối tuần. Một nhóm đồng nghiệp tuyệt vời và cơ hội phát triển trong nhà hàng.

SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
The Role
As a Software Engineer in our Backend team, you are part of our tech team based in Stockholm or Halmstad. You will be a part of building and developing the next generation investment platform. Your role involves close collaboration with fellow Software Engineers, as well as with Data Scientists, Product Designers and Product Managers.
Your Mission
Build Software Features in a fast paced environment

Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective

Contribute towards improving our tech stack, architecture, and operational methods

Collaborate and build high-quality products by following good engineering practices

Develop integrations to third-party API's

Embrace our learning culture by both receiving and providing feedback, and be open to getting constructive feedback on your code

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...
Are a motivated engineer with a passion for software development 

Recognize the importance of collaboration in order to build a great product, and enjoys engaging with colleagues to exchange ideas and concepts

Have 5+ years professional software development experience

Are a team player who is open to everyone’s opinions

Have experience from working in a scalable, product-based environment

Are fluent in English

Are either a Swedish citizen or holds a valid EU work permit. Unfortunately, we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role

If you possess a different profile but believe you have relevant skills and can excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and share your motivation with us.
Our Cultural DNAAt SAVR, we’re:
🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing
We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in.
What’s In It for You
You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
Here’s what we offer:
💻 Top-tier work gear
💰 Competitive salary
🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance
🤒 Insurance package
🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
🥗 Stocked pantry, plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high
Our Commitment to Diversity
SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Ready to Join Us?
We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

An Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining automated production systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving PLCs, robots, and other automated equipment, supporting both new production line installations and ongoing process improvements. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with cloud platforms to enable traceability, analysis, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production.

The Opportunity
In this role as a Software Design Engineer at Hitachi Energy you will be a part of a Global HVDC Control & Protection Software team. Our team is responsible for Protection, we have interfaces towards other domains within Control & Protection, IT/OT, Hardware and Operations.
Our team is responsible for developing, integrating, and maintaining software functionalities that ensure system supervision, communication, and system monitoring within the HVDC control system, based on the MACH (Modular Advanced Control System for HVDC & GPQSS) platform.​
We deliver System Supervision & Communication solutions for HVDC projects worldwide, covering the full software lifecycle — from design and development to integration, testing, and verification — in both real-time and virtual environments.
